description:

## Task Context

- Create src/queue/bid-events.ts:

description:
# ORCHESTRATOR: DO scaffold: constructor, fetch routing, WS upgrade, helpers

You coordinate child steps for this task.

## Task
**Category:** functional

Rewrite src/auction/durableObject.ts stub into WebSocket Hibernation API scaffold.

## Steps
- Constructor: extend DurableObject (from 'cloudflare:workers'), store ctx/env, init empty AuctionRoomState, call setWebSocketAutoResponse for ping/pong
- fetch() routing:
  - POST /init: load auction + lots from D1 (env.DB with Kysely), populate AuctionRoomState, persist to ctx.storage, return 200
  - POST /add-lot: parse lot data, add to state.lots, broadcast lot_update, return 200
  - GET with Upgrade:websocket: create WebSocket pair, read X-User-Id/X-Username/X-Is-Admin headers, ctx.acceptWebSocket(server, tags), serializeAttachment({userId, username, isAdmin}), increment viewerCount, broadcast viewer_count, send state snapshot, return upgrade response
  - Default: return 404
- Helper: broadcast(msg: ServerMessage, tag?: string) — JSON.stringify, iterate ctx.getWebSockets(tag), try/catch send
- Helper: sendToSocket(ws, msg) — try send, close on error
- State recovery: on hibernation wake, rebuild viewerCount from ctx.getWebSockets().length, restore AuctionRoomState from ctx.storage.get()
- webSocketClose(): call ws.close(code, reason), decrement viewerCount, broadcast viewer_count
- webSocketError(): decrement viewerCount
- Import DurableObject from 'cloudflare:workers'
- Types: AuctionRoomState, LotState, ServerMessage from './types'

## Files
- Rewrite: src/auction/durableObject.ts

## Test Steps
1. DO class extends DurableObject correctly
2. fetch() routes to correct handler based on method + path
3. POST /init loads data from D1 and populates state
4. WebSocket upgrade creates pair, attaches metadata, sends state snapshot
5. broadcast() sends to all connected sockets
6. webSocketClose() decrements viewerCount and broadcasts

title: Get bearings for DO lot countdown alarms + anti-snipe
description:
# BEARINGS PHASE

## Goal
1. Verify the codebase is in a healthy state
2. Understand the relevant code for this task

## Task Context
Implement alarm-based countdown for going_once -> going_twice -> sold transitions with anti-snipe.

## Steps
- alarm() handler: get current lot, if going_once -> transition to going_twice + set alarm 5s + broadcast lot_update, if going_twice -> transition to sold (record winner) or passed (no bids) + flush buffer + broadcast lot_update
- Anti-snipe: bid during going_once/going_twice resets to active + ctx.storage.deleteAlarm() (handled in bid handler, but alarm() must guard against race)
- Buffer flush helper: collect BufferedBidEvents, send via env.BID_EVENTS_QUEUE.sendBatch(), clear buffer, also flush when buffer reaches 10 events

## Files
- Modify: src/auction/durableObject.ts

## Test Steps
1. Admin triggers going_once -> alarm set for 5s
2. After 5s, alarm fires -> lot transitions to going_twice, new alarm set
3. After another 5s -> lot transitions to sold (bids) or passed (no bids)
4. Bid during going_once -> alarm cancelled, lot back to active
5. Bid during going_twice -> alarm cancelled, lot back to active
6. Buffer flushed to BID_EVENTS_QUEUE on lot close
7. Buffer flushed when reaching 10 events
8. Race condition: alarm fires but lot already reset -> no transition
9. Winner recorded correctly on sold
10. sendBatch called with correct BufferedBidEvent format

title: Implement DO lot countdown alarms + anti-snipe
description:
# IMPLEMENTATION PHASE

## Goal

## Task Context
Implement alarm-based countdown for going_once -> going_twice -> sold transitions with anti-snipe.

## Steps
- alarm() handler: get current lot, if going_once -> transition to going_twice + set alarm 5s + broadcast lot_update, if going_twice -> transition to sold (record winner) or passed (no bids) + flush buffer + broadcast lot_update
- Anti-snipe: bid during going_once/going_twice resets to active + ctx.storage.deleteAlarm() (handled in bid handler, but alarm() must guard against race)
- Buffer flush helper: collect BufferedBidEvents, send via env.BID_EVENTS_QUEUE.sendBatch(), clear buffer, also flush when buffer reaches 10 events

## Files
- Modify: src/auction/durableObject.ts

1. Admin triggers going_once -> alarm set for 5s
2. After 5s, alarm fires -> lot transitions to going_twice, new alarm set
3. After another 5s -> lot transitions to sold (bids) or passed (no bids)
4. Bid during going_once -> alarm cancelled, lot back to active
5. Bid during going_twice -> alarm cancelled, lot back to active
6. Buffer flushed to BID_EVENTS_QUEUE on lot close
7. Buffer flushed when reaching 10 events
8. Race condition: alarm fires but lot already reset -> no transition

## Steps
- Constructor: extend DurableObject (from 'cloudflare:workers'), store ctx/env, init empty AuctionRoomState, call setWebSocketAutoResponse for ping/pong
- fetch() routing:
  - POST /init: load auction + lots from D1 (env.DB with Kysely), populate AuctionRoomState, persist to ctx.storage, return 200
  - POST /add-lot: parse lot data, add to state.lots, broadcast lot_update, return 200
  - GET with Upgrade:websocket: create WebSocket pair, read X-User-Id/X-Username/X-Is-Admin headers, ctx.acceptWebSocket(server, tags), serializeAttachment({userId, username, isAdmin}), increment viewerCount, broadcast viewer_count, send state snapshot, return upgrade response
  - Default: return 404
- Helper: broadcast(msg: ServerMessage, tag?: string) — JSON.stringify, iterate ctx.getWebSockets(tag), try/catch send
- Helper: sendToSocket(ws, msg) — try send, close on error
- State recovery: on hibernation wake, rebuild viewerCount from ctx.getWebSockets().length, restore AuctionRoomState from ctx.storage.get()
- webSocketClose(): call ws.close(code, reason), decrement viewerCount, broadcast viewer_count
- webSocketError(): decrement viewerCount

description:
# ORCHESTRATOR: DO admin lot controls: transitions + broadcasts

You coordinate child steps for this task.

## Task
**Category:** functional

Implement AdminMessage handlers in AuctionRoomDO.webSocketMessage() for lot control commands.

## Steps
- Check isAdmin from deserializeAttachment() — reject non-admin messages
- going_once: validate lot is active via canTransitionLot(), transition, set alarm 5s, broadcast lot_update
- going_twice: validate lot is going_once, transition, set alarm 5s, broadcast lot_update
- sold: validate lot is going_once/going_twice/active, transition to sold, record winner, cancel alarm, flush buffer, broadcast lot_update
- pass: transition to passed, cancel alarm, flush buffer, broadcast lot_update
- withdraw: transition to withdrawn, cancel alarm, flush buffer, broadcast lot_update
- advance_lot: find next pending lot by lotNumber order, set as currentLotId, transition to active, broadcast lot_update + auction_update
- start_auction: update auction status to live in D1, update state.status, broadcast auction_update
- close_auction: update auction status to closed in D1, broadcast auction_update

- AdminMessage types already defined in types.ts

description:
# COMMIT PHASE

## Goal
Create a clean git commit with the changes.

## Task Context
Rewrite src/auction/durableObject.ts stub into WebSocket Hibernation API scaffold.

## Steps
- Constructor: extend DurableObject (from 'cloudflare:workers'), store ctx/env, init empty AuctionRoomState, call setWebSocketAutoResponse for ping/pong
- fetch() routing:
  - POST /init: load auction + lots from D1 (env.DB with Kysely), populate AuctionRoomState, persist to ctx.storage, return 200
  - POST /add-lot: parse lot data, add to state.lots, broadcast lot_update, return 200
  - GET with Upgrade:websocket: create WebSocket pair, read X-User-Id/X-Username/X-Is-Admin headers, ctx.acceptWebSocket(server, tags), serializeAttachment({userId, username, isAdmin}), increment viewerCount, broadcast viewer_count, send state snapshot, return upgrade response
  - Default: return 404
- Helper: broadcast(msg: ServerMessage, tag?: string) — JSON.stringify, iterate ctx.getWebSockets(tag), try/catch send
- Helper: sendToSocket(ws, msg) — try send, close on error
- State recovery: on hibernation wake, rebuild viewerCount from ctx.getWebSockets().length, restore AuctionRoomState from ctx.storage.get()
- webSocketClose(): call ws.close(code, reason), decrement viewerCount, broadcast viewer_count
- webSocketError(): decrement viewerCount
- Import DurableObject from 'cloudflare:workers'

title: Verify DO scaffold: constructor, fetch routing, WS upgrade, helpers
description:
# VERIFICATION PHASE

## Goal
Validate that the implementation works correctly through automated AND manual verification.

## Task Context
Rewrite src/auction/durableObject.ts stub into WebSocket Hibernation API scaffold.

## Steps
- Constructor: extend DurableObject (from 'cloudflare:workers'), store ctx/env, init empty AuctionRoomState, call setWebSocketAutoResponse for ping/pong
- fetch() routing:
  - POST /init: load auction + lots from D1 (env.DB with Kysely), populate AuctionRoomState, persist to ctx.storage, return 200
  - POST /add-lot: parse lot data, add to state.lots, broadcast lot_update, return 200
  - GET with Upgrade:websocket: create WebSocket pair, read X-User-Id/X-Username/X-Is-Admin headers, ctx.acceptWebSocket(server, tags), serializeAttachment({userId, username, isAdmin}), increment viewerCount, broadcast viewer_count, send state snapshot, return upgrade response
  - Default: return 404
- Helper: broadcast(msg: ServerMessage, tag?: string) — JSON.stringify, iterate ctx.getWebSockets(tag), try/catch send
- Helper: sendToSocket(ws, msg) — try send, close on error
- State recovery: on hibernation wake, rebuild viewerCount from ctx.getWebSockets().length, restore AuctionRoomState from ctx.storage.get()
- webSocketClose(): call ws.close(code, reason), decrement viewerCount, broadcast viewer_count
- webSocketError(): decrement viewerCount
- Import DurableObject from 'cloudflare:workers'
- Types: AuctionRoomState, LotState, ServerMessage from './types'

## Files
- Rewrite: src/auction/durableObject.ts

## Test Steps
1. DO class extends DurableObject correctly
2. fetch() routes to correct handler based on method + path
3. POST /init loads data from D1 and populates state
4. WebSocket upgrade creates pair, attaches metadata, sends state snapshot
5. broadcast() sends to all connected sockets
6. webSocketClose() decrements viewerCount and broadcasts
7. State persists to ctx.storage and recovers after hibernation wake
8. setWebSocketAutoResponse configured for ping/pong
9. TypeScript compiles without errors

## Automated Checks

1. **Run type checking** - Check CLAUDE.md or package.json for commands (e.g., `bun typecheck`)

title: Verify WebSocket upgrade middleware in worker.tsx
description:
# VERIFICATION PHASE

## Goal
Validate that the implementation works correctly through automated AND manual verification.

## Task Context
Add middleware to worker.tsx that intercepts WebSocket upgrade requests to /ws/auction/:id and forwards to AuctionRoomDO.

## Steps
- After session middleware, before render(): check URL matches /ws/auction/{id} AND has Upgrade:websocket header
- Require authenticated session (ctx.user), return 401 if not
- Extract auction ID from URL path
- Determine isAdmin from ctx.membership.role (super_admin/admin/auctioneer)
- Create new Request with headers: X-User-Id, X-Username, X-Is-Admin
- Forward to env.AUCTION_ROOM.get(env.AUCTION_ROOM.idFromName(auctionId)).fetch(request)
- Return DO response (WebSocket upgrade)

## Context
- Session middleware already populates ctx.user and ctx.membership
- Middleware chain: setCommonHeaders -> R2 images -> session -> [WS here] -> render()

1. GET /ws/auction/abc with Upgrade:websocket + valid session -> 101
2. No session -> 401
3. Regular GET without Upgrade header -> falls through to render
4. Non-matching paths -> not intercepted
5. X-User-Id, X-Username, X-Is-Admin headers forwarded

- Check isAdmin from deserializeAttachment() — reject non-admin messages

title: Commit DO lot countdown alarms + anti-snipe
description:
# COMMIT PHASE

## Goal
Create a clean git commit with the changes.

## Task Context
Implement alarm-based countdown for going_once -> going_twice -> sold transitions with anti-snipe.

## Steps
- alarm() handler: get current lot, if going_once -> transition to going_twice + set alarm 5s + broadcast lot_update, if going_twice -> transition to sold (record winner) or passed (no bids) + flush buffer + broadcast lot_update
- Anti-snipe: bid during going_once/going_twice resets to active + ctx.storage.deleteAlarm() (handled in bid handler, but alarm() must guard against race)
- Buffer flush helper: collect BufferedBidEvents, send via env.BID_EVENTS_QUEUE.sendBatch(), clear buffer, also flush when buffer reaches 10 events

## Files
- Modify: src/auction/durableObject.ts

## Test Steps
1. Admin triggers going_once -> alarm set for 5s
2. After 5s, alarm fires -> lot transitions to going_twice, new alarm set
3. After another 5s -> lot transitions to sold (bids) or passed (no bids)
4. Bid during going_once -> alarm cancelled, lot back to active
5. Bid during going_twice -> alarm cancelled, lot back to active
6. Buffer flushed to BID_EVENTS_QUEUE on lot close
7. Buffer flushed when reaching 10 events
8. Race condition: alarm fires but lot already reset -> no transition
9. Winner recorded correctly on sold

description:
# ORCHESTRATOR: WebSocket upgrade middleware in worker.tsx

You coordinate child steps for this task.

## Task
**Category:** infrastructure

Add middleware to worker.tsx that intercepts WebSocket upgrade requests to /ws/auction/:id and forwards to AuctionRoomDO.

## Steps
- After session middleware, before render(): check URL matches /ws/auction/{id} AND has Upgrade:websocket header
- Require authenticated session (ctx.user), return 401 if not
- Extract auction ID from URL path
- Determine isAdmin from ctx.membership.role (super_admin/admin/auctioneer)
- Create new Request with headers: X-User-Id, X-Username, X-Is-Admin

- Return DO response (WebSocket upgrade)

- Constructor: extend DurableObject (from 'cloudflare:workers'), store ctx/env, init empty AuctionRoomState, call setWebSocketAutoResponse for ping/pong
- fetch() routing:
  - POST /init: load auction + lots from D1 (env.DB with Kysely), populate AuctionRoomState, persist to ctx.storage, return 200

  - Default: return 404
- Helper: broadcast(msg: ServerMessage, tag?: string) — JSON.stringify, iterate ctx.getWebSockets(tag), try/catch send
- Helper: sendToSocket(ws, msg) — try send, close on error
- State recovery: on hibernation wake, rebuild viewerCount from ctx.getWebSockets().length, restore AuctionRoomState from ctx.storage.get()
- webSocketClose(): call ws.close(code, reason), decrement viewerCount, broadcast viewer_count
- webSocketError(): decrement viewerCount
- Import DurableObject from 'cloudflare:workers'

title: Verify DO admin lot controls: transitions + broadcasts
description:
# VERIFICATION PHASE

## Goal
Validate that the implementation works correctly through automated AND manual verification.

## Task Context
Implement AdminMessage handlers in AuctionRoomDO.webSocketMessage() for lot control commands.

## Steps
- Check isAdmin from deserializeAttachment() — reject non-admin messages
- going_once: validate lot is active via canTransitionLot(), transition, set alarm 5s, broadcast lot_update
- going_twice: validate lot is going_once, transition, set alarm 5s, broadcast lot_update
- sold: validate lot is going_once/going_twice/active, transition to sold, record winner, cancel alarm, flush buffer, broadcast lot_update
- pass: transition to passed, cancel alarm, flush buffer, broadcast lot_update
- withdraw: transition to withdrawn, cancel alarm, flush buffer, broadcast lot_update
- advance_lot: find next pending lot by lotNumber order, set as currentLotId, transition to active, broadcast lot_update + auction_update
- start_auction: update auction status to live in D1, update state.status, broadcast auction_update
- close_auction: update auction status to closed in D1, broadcast auction_update

## Context
- canTransitionLot(from, to) from src/auction/state-machine.ts
- AdminMessage types already defined in types.ts

## Files
- Modify: src/auction/durableObject.ts

## Test Steps
1. Non-admin sends admin message -> rejected
2. going_once on active lot -> lot transitions, alarm set
3. going_twice on going_once lot -> transitions, alarm set
4. sold -> winner recorded, buffer flushed, lot_update broadcast
5. pass -> lot closed without winner
6. withdraw -> lot removed from active
